title: The Long Ear
text: A dish the size of a valley on Teth, Nereid's moon: Meridian's link to Sol. The Biosphere Reports end up here after Sela, Ash and Cinder relay them, and go out in one tight beam every sol. Nothing has ever come back down it: twelve runs of reports, and Sol has never answered. Tuning it (hold its three rim plates while the dish swings; long-ear) makes it ours: a one-way line to Sol, four years and three months at the speed of light. In the Covenant and Proof endings Accord sends its own report down it.
